parts.title: Find work with friction
parts.body: Walk through a process from trigger to final decision. Note handoffs, repeated searches, waiting time, rework, and decisions made with incomplete information. Ask workers where exceptions appear; the happy path rarely explains the real cost. Classify opportunities as assist, automate a bounded step, or redesign a workflow.
parts.label: Understand

parts.title: Observe a claims team
parts.body: Map intake, document review, coverage check, decision, and customer reply. Interview an adjuster about exceptions and appeals. Identify a narrow first experiment, such as summarizing source documents with citations, and record the human review needed before a claim decision.
parts.label: Apply
